messages:
toni (Design): quick design review: updating Compliance > Encryption region picker to make it clear which regions use Redwood-managed keys and which support customer KMS (BYOK). mock attached. asking for copy, accessibility, and keyboard feedback.

mohit (Product): love the clarity. two product asks: auto-select account default region but let users override, and expand BYOK once in helper copy to 'bring your own key' so non-technical folks understand.

kevin (Eng): implementation notes: custom combobox for modern browsers, fallback to native select for older UAs. follow ARIA combobox pattern: aria-activedescendant on options, aria-describedby for helper text, and a polite aria-live status that announces selection changes. avoid putting helper text inside the listbox.

samir (Security): copy precision: avoid vague label "Encrypted". use explicit labels like "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". replace any UI text that says "key id" with "key reference". helper text should explicitly state that audit logs will include region + key reference when customer-managed keys are used.

allegra (PM): UX question: if a tenant hasn't configured BYOK, show the BYOK option disabled with a tooltip: "Requires uploaded key and IAM role  see docs." keep the option visible so users know capability exists.

toni (Design): plan: display compact badges with icon + short label (not color-only), and add helper line under the control: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." we'll wire that helper with aria-describedby and include a small "learn more" link.

mohit (Product): when switching to BYOK show a confirmation modal: title: "Switch to customer-managed KMS (BYOK)", body: "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. You must upload or grant access to the key to complete." include propagation note: "Changes may take up to 2 minutes to propagate." buttons: Cancel / Continue.

kevin (Eng): accessibility bits: set modal initial focus to primary action, trap focus, allow Esc to close, and ensure screen readers see the modal label. aria-live announcement example: "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key reference." tests should assert aria-describedby present and aria-live updates correctly.

a11y-bot: quick checklist: combobox/role pattern present, aria-activedescendant updates with keyboard arrows, aria-describedby references helper copy, focus outline visible on keyboard nav, badge text contrast >= 4.5:1. flagged items require manual review.

samir (Security): audit log example to standardize: action: inference.request, region: eu-west-1, key_reference: projects/abc/keys/key-123 (customer-managed). ensure UI tooltip uses the term "key reference" to match logs; add note in modal that key material never leaves customer control.

toni (Design): punchlist I'll deliver: 1) labels: "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)"; 2) helper text (aria-describedby): "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used."; 3) disabled BYOK tooltip copy; 4) confirmation modal copy + propagation note; 5) keyboard + aria-live pattern; 6) badges with icon + color (not color-only). I'll push updated mock and an a11y checklist to the ticket later today. Thanks all!
